## Per machine: firmware, what works, what does not

### Beelink mini PC (U55)
- Firmware needed: Secure Boot must be off for dev builds (unsigned)
- What works: none recorded
- What does not (known gaps): Wi-Fi, CPU microcode (not in the image yet)

### Dell all-in-one (model 7459), the planned daily hub
- Firmware needed: non-free firmware and CPU microcode are not in the image yet (needs a founder decision)
- What works: none recorded
- What does not (known gaps): Wi-Fi and Bluetooth (no firmware in the image); CPU microcode updates (not installed); GPU acceleration (no driver in the image); the machine's own screen shows an address and QR code, not the dashboard

### DigitalOcean droplet (cloud image, BIOS boot)
- Firmware needed: none recorded
- What works: none recorded
- What does not (known gaps): no Secure Boot, no TPM on a droplet (an expected limit, not a failure)

### Raspberry Pi 5 (4 GB and 16 GB)
- Firmware needed: Raspberry Pi firmware with tryboot (A/B switch); EEPROM boot order must include NVMe (6) or USB (4)
- What works: none recorded
- What does not (known gaps): never booted by this image on a real Pi 5 (only desk checks in a VM)

## Reference box criteria for gate G1

The reference box is the one machine we name as the buy-this-one answer. It must meet all of these, measured by the kit shown, on the real machine.

| ID | Criterion | Measured by |
|---|---|---|
| RB-1 | The shipping installer image installs onto the internal disk and reaches the dashboard with no keyboard after the first screen. | `LT-X86-01` |
| RB-2 | A good update commits on the other slot and a bad update rolls back by itself, 10 of 10 times. | `G1` |
| RB-3 | Power pulled at each update phase, 20 of 20 times, the box comes back healthy on a good slot. | `G1` |
| RB-4 | The disk is an SSD or NVMe (a spinning disk makes k3s feel stuck). | `LT-X86-00` |
| RB-5 | Wired network works from the first boot; any Wi-Fi claim is listed only after it is tested. | `LT-X86-00` |
| RB-6 | The machine's TPM and Secure Boot state are recorded, even if the answer is none. | `LT-X86-00` |
| RB-7 | RAM is at least 16 GB so apps, the gateway and k3s fit together. | `LT-X86-00` |
| RB-8 | A backup is restored onto the box from a recovery key in under 60 minutes. | `G1` |
| RB-9 | No drive lock-in; any standard SATA or NVMe disk works. | `LT-X86-00` |
